text:
alex: Heads up — incident-bot did not page the on-call for a SEV1 alert from notify-orch at ~11:03 UTC. Only the Slack thread showed up, no SMS/pager deliveries.

ops-bot: automated alert: notify-orch -> pagerflow webhook returned HTTP 502 (upstream connect error). attempt=1, body truncated.

maria: I didn't receive any pages. Only saw this Slack thread. Was there a suppressor active?

jordan: I actually got a page at 11:18 (about 15m after the alert). Customer on-call said they didn't get anything until we manually paged.

alex: I sent manual pages to the oncall group at 11:22 using `pagerctl page oncall --manual`.

lia: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-failures — likely webhook proxy or parser. eng-infra can you check notify-orch -> pagerflow logs and suppression logic?

eng-infra: Confirming 502 spike from pagerflow gateway 11:02–11:10. Curl snippet reproducing error:

```
$ curl -I -X POST https://pagerflow.internal/webhook
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: envoy
x-error: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
```

eng-infra: Also seeing a recent config rotation for webhook-signer that coincides with the window. Rolling back cert/key for signer for a subset of traffic temporarily.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollback webhook-signer v1.3.7 -> v1.3.6 by @eng-infra (PR #428). Started 11:30, finished 11:34.

sre-lead: Action items: (1) disable suppressor for notify-orch until retries are validated, (2) trigger manual paging fallback if webhook returns 5xx, (3) support to collect customer impact. Lia please coordinate. Also open an incident ticket for missed pages.

maria: Support reports ~22 customers experienced increased latency; 3 customers reported missed SLA notifications. Example request IDs: req-abc123, req-def456, req-xyz789.

alex: Created incident record INC-2026-113: "Pagerflow webhook 5xx + suppression mis-eval -> missed pages". Adding timeline and manual mitigation notes.

ops-bot: suppression audit: rule `suppress_if_channel_has_thread` evaluated true because thread metadata contained a stale indicator header. Root cause appears to be parser treating `X-Thread-Indicator: true` present in older-format alerts as suppressor trigger. PR #429 opened.

eng-infra: Hotfix merged to notification parser to ignore legacy `X-Thread-Indicator` in incoming webhook headers. Patch rolled to prod at 11:50. Monitoring delivery metrics now.

jordan: Received SMS at 11:52 after hotfix. Manual pages confirmed delivered earlier. Will watch for 2h and escalate if reoccurs.

alex: Thanks all — good triage. Retro scheduled for tomorrow to review suppression rules + webhook-signer rotation process. :thumbsup:
